tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Screen background. Dark is the first theme; the app follows the phone's system theme.

tokens.name: surface-bar
tokens.usage: Tab bar and header.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Post card, settings rows, secondary button.

tokens.name: elevated
tokens.usage: Gender-question card, selected segment.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Track of the Feed | Clips segmented control.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Borders of buttons, chips and action pills; top rule of the tab bar.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Row dividers inside cards.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Frame of the gender-question card and the lock line.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, card and elevated. ≥ 15:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Caption under a photo, values in rows. On surface and card.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, counts, tab labels, hints. On surface and card: 7.5:1 dark, 4.9:1 light.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary action: Share, Yes, Follow, the create button, the active tab. There is no accent colour in the system — this is the accent.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an action fill.

tokens.name: action-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the lock line and the wall marker.

tokens.name: wall
tokens.usage: Everything that belongs to the gender wall: the lock, the Business badge, the question frame. An alias of action so the wall can be recoloured in one edit if an accent ever appears.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring: solid 2px with a 2px gap in surface. ≥ 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: photo-fallback
tokens.usage: Placeholder under a photo while it loads.

groups.name: Headings
groups.note: One family; weight carries the hierarchy. Manrope from Google Fonts, full Cyrillic and Latin.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The gender question in the composer. The only large heading in the app.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Enrolment for the junior group is open. Tuesdays and Thursdays at 17:00.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Seven o'clock light on Kichik Gala.
styles.usage: Caption under a photo. No handle in front — the handle is already in the post header.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Text in action pills, small buttons, counts.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Place and time under the handle, values in rows.

styles.name: note
styles.sample: Only posts marked for sharing are shown here
styles.usage: The lock line and the reach line.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Business badge and section labels, always in caps.

styles.name: tab
styles.usage: Tab labels; the active one is weight 600.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its count, between chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between buttons in a row, between action pills.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card inset, photo inset inside a card, side margin of cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Side margin of the screen and text. The base step.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between profile blocks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Reserved for empty states.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Business badge.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, composer rows, the lock line.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Photo inside a card, profile grid tiles, caption field.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Post card, gender-question card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, action pills, the Feed | Clips control, badges.

tokens.name: radius-device
tokens.usage: Mockups only: the phone frame corner.

size.note: Control heights and sizes. Minimum touch target 44.

tokens.name: header
tokens.usage: Screen header height.

tokens.name: tabbar
tokens.usage: Tab bar height without the safe area.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Yes and No buttons in the gender question.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Follow, Message, settings rows (46).

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Share in the header.

tokens.name: pill
tokens.usage: Action pills under a post.

tokens.name: create
tokens.usage: The round create button in the tab bar.

tokens.name: avatar-sm
tokens.usage: Avatar in a post header.

tokens.name: avatar-lg
tokens.usage: Avatar on a profile.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Icons in the header, tab bar and rows.
